cases.sentence: Скажи Тиру, расположенному у ___, купцу народов на многих берегах: Так говорит Владыка Господь:
cases.explain: «морских ворот» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord Yahweh says: “You, Tyre, have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’

cases.explain: «открытое море» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.

cases.explain: «опытные ремесленники» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The old men of Gebal and its wise men were your repairers of ship seams in you. All the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to deal in your merchandise.

cases.sentence: Жители Бет-Тогармы давали в обмен на твои товары тягловых и ___ и мулов.
cases.explain: «боевых коней» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.

cases.sentence: Роданитяне вели с тобой торговлю; ___ были твоими базарами.
cases.explain: «многие побережья» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange.

cases.sentence: Он давал в обмен на твои товары бирюзу, пурпурные ткани, вышитые изделия, ___, кораллы и рубины.
cases.explain: «тонкий лен» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.

cases.sentence: Дамаск торговал с тобой вином из Хелбона и шерстью из Цахара, потому что у тебя было много добра и ___.
cases.explain: «несметных богатств» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks, by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

cases.sentence: Дедан торговал с тобой попонами для ___.
cases.explain: «верховой езды» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “Dedan was your trafficker in precious cloths for riding.

cases.sentence: Они давали в обмен на твои товары лучшие из пряностей, ___ и золото.
cases.explain: «драгоценные камни» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.

cases.sentence: На твоем рынке они вели с тобой торговлю ___, голубыми тканями, шитьем и разноцветными коврами, которые были надежно связаны веревками.
cases.explain: «дорогой одеждой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in chests of rich clothing, bound with cords and made of cedar, among your merchandise.

cases.sentence: На твоем рынке они вели с тобой торговлю дорогой одеждой, ___, шитьем и разноцветными коврами, которые были надежно связаны веревками.
cases.explain: «голубыми тканями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in chests of rich clothing, bound with cords and made of cedar, among your merchandise.

cases.sentence: На твоем рынке они вели с тобой торговлю дорогой одеждой, голубыми тканями, шитьем и ___, которые были надежно связаны веревками.
cases.explain: «разноцветными коврами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in chests of rich clothing, bound with cords and made of cedar, among your merchandise.

cases.explain: «Таршишские корабли» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise. You were replenished and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.
